adjudication.rationale: In `AddGuestsDialog.tsx` the `onError` handler builds `const message = `${err.data?.code}: ${t(err.message)}`;` and then calls `showToast(message || t("unable_to_add_guests"), "error")`. A template literal always produces a (truthy) string, so the `unable_to_add_guests` fallback is effectively unreachable. When `err.data?.code` is missing, the toast will display `undefined: ...`, matching the finding. The diff clearly introduces this behavior.
